We have applied three templates in order: 324324 gave precursors: product (target) -> two fragments: "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1" and "Nc1ccccc1N". Wait the result tuple: (('Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1', 'Nc1ccccc1N'),). So first step: target splits into sulfonamide attached to aromatic ring and an aniline (para?).

Second template 1914396 applied to the first fragment gave: ("Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=O)cc2)cc1", "O=C(O)CC(=O)O"). So that splits the side chain: the /C=C/C(=O)O part becomes C=O (aldehyde?) Actually product is aromatic sulfonamide with phenyl ring bearing C=O (aldehyde) and the other fragment is O=C(O)CC(=O)O (malonic acid? Actually it's HOOC-CH2-COOH). Good.

Third template 733 applied to the second fragment (the aromatic sulfonamide with aldehyde) gave something? We haven't applied yet. We need to apply template 733 to "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=O)cc2)cc1". Let's apply.
